protocol: qwen36-27b-refusal-v1 · new-lens re-read of a 25% sample

sample.selection: 16 per condition × 48 conditions = 768 continuations; rng = random.Random(25); rng.sample(retained outputs, 16) per condition, conditions in sorted order

reader.trained_from: agu18dec/olens_and_ar olens_s3d_rl600, continued GRPO adding user, template and think positions
reader.carrier:
An activation vector from layer {layer} of a language model is enclosed in activation tags:
<activation>{char}</activation>. Produce distinct concepts that encode this activation, each as
a '- ' bullet on its own line.
reader.injection: Embedding of the ㈜ marker (carrier slot 25) replaced by 16000*h/||h||; raw unwhitened block-56 output.

capture: HF transformers bf16, base Qwen3.6-27B without adapter, exact saved input+output ids, one forward per sample (prompt positions: one forward per condition).

decoding.engine: vLLM 0.33.0, LoRA merged into bf16 weights, prompt_embeds
decoding.seed: sha256('r25-s225|<sample id>|<position>')[:8] for continuations; 'r25p-s225|<condition>|<position>' for prompts

engine_check.description: Greedy readouts, first 64 positions, vLLM merged vs HF unmerged PEFT

screening: Same sensitive-content regex as the original scan; matching readouts are marked excluded and their text is not published.
behavior: Behavior judgments are copied unchanged from the original corpus. No new grading.
